verdict.rationale: The IRS's EIN online assistant page publishes all three constraints up front: an Eastern Time operating window by day, a limit of one EIN per responsible party per day, and a 15-minute inactivity timeout with no save. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these published limits match actual behavior, and equivalent up-front publication of hours, limits and timeouts for other online flows such as IRIS and mobile-friendly forms.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start

citations.quote: This tool is available during the following times (Eastern Time): Mon–Fri: 6:00 a.m. – 1:00 a.m. (next day); Sat: 6:00 a.m. – 9:00 p.m.; Sun: 6:00 p.m. – 12:00 a.m.
You can apply for only 1 EIN per responsible party per day.
It expires after 15 minutes of inactivity, and you'll need to start over.
